inspected_thresholds.observations: Current ANC <1.5 or platelets <75 holds chemotherapy; after recovery within two weeks, nadir ANC 0.5 to <1 or platelets 10 to <50 reduces irinotecan and both 5-FU components by one relative dose level; ANC <0.5 or platelets <10 by two levels. Source level sequences match JSON: irinotecan 180/150/120; 5-FU bolus 400/320/260; infusion 2400/1900/1500; folinic 400/400/400. Source ANC two-week maximum delay versus four-week discontinuation clause remains explicitly unresolved by ANC_INTERVAL_CONFLICT.
inspected_thresholds.outcome: No new numeric mismatch substantiated in this inspected subset; source conflict and review limits persist.

inspected_thresholds.observations: Retained source contraindicates irinotecan bilirubin >3 x ULN; renal irinotecan note gives no routine reduction with caution, distinct from 00330/331. Source severe-renal exclusion lacks numeric threshold and conflicts with a 5-FU reduction note; current code preserves exclusion plus consultant/pharmacy clarification. 5-FU bilirubin >85 micromol/L OR AST >180 U/L contraindicates; exact equality has explicit review instead of invented clearance. Moderate/severe hepatic reductions are review decisions.
inspected_thresholds.outcome: No new numeric mismatch substantiated in this inspected subset; existing severe-renal source conflict remains.

inspected_thresholds.observations: Irinotecan full resolution is stated on p3. Table5 current diarrhoea >=2 holds FOLFIRI, persistent >=2 after two weeks discontinues; recovered worst grades3/4 reduce irinotecan and 5-FU one/two levels. Mucositis >=2 hold, recovery <=1, worst3/4 reduces only 5-FU one/two levels; JSON matches this mucositis component distinction. Before two weeks current diarrhoea >=2 is encoded only as irinotecan hold; see discrepancy H328-DIARRHOEA-COMPONENT-HOLD.
inspected_thresholds.outcome: Retained-source component discrepancy requires fresh-source confirmation; no current clinical-defect claim.

inspected_thresholds.observations: ANC <1.5/platelets <75 holds both; recovered nadir ANC 0.5 to <1 or platelets 10 to <50 uses irinotecan150, more severe nadirs120 with cetuximab maintained if otherwise suitable. ANC <0.5 after two weeks stops irinotecan only, cetuximab continuation is discretionary. CrCl <10 or haemodialysis gives 50-66% original irinotecan as a range, not a fabricated fixed dose; bilirubin >3 x ULN contraindicates irinotecan.
inspected_thresholds.outcome: No new numeric mismatch substantiated in this inspected subset; routine range selection remains specialist-only.

inspected_thresholds.observations: Same inspected blood/organ thresholds as 00330 with fortnightly cetuximab500mg/m2 preserved. The JSON retains irinotecan150/120 recovery doses, irinotecan-only ANC stop, source renal 50-66% range and bilirubin >3 x ULN contraindication.
inspected_thresholds.outcome: No new numeric mismatch substantiated in this inspected subset.

inspected_thresholds.observations: Current grade >=3 holds cetuximab; restart gates require recovery <=2, a documented >0 and <=2-week interruption, occurrence and no failed recovery. Occurrence1/2/3 doses are weekly250/200/150 for 00328/330, fortnightly500/400/300 for00331; fourth severe episode discontinues. Failed recovery has explicit stop/review.
inspected_thresholds.outcome: No new dose/recurrence mismatch substantiated in this inspected subset; source-currentness and clinical review remain incomplete.

retained_source_discrepancies.engine_observation: Overall withhold, but only irinotecan dose row; no 5-FU or folinic component holds. At delay2 weeks the separate stop rule correctly targets all FOLFIRI components. Overall withhold alone does not prove all required components have been withheld.
retained_source_discrepancies.existing_test_gap: All534 existing v0.83.6 cases pass; diarrhoea hold test asserts global action and does not assert this full component set.
retained_source_discrepancies.recommendation: Preserve finding on development branch; confirm a fresh authoritative source before treating this as current source reconciliation. Any future repair needs grade2/3/4 current-diarrhoea component assertions before two weeks, preserving grade1 irinotecan-only hold, independent cetuximab suitability, two-week stopping and recovered-dose behavior.

review_questions.detail: Already declared in prior source map: weekly cetuximab250mg/m2 maintenance conflicts with Table3 grade3/4 restart400/300mg/m2. Current engine avoids calculating a cetuximab dose and requires review. Do not resolve by borrowing fortnightly schedule.

Retained Table3 says delay grade3/4 diarrhoea until grade2 or less within2 weeks. JSON instead holds irinotecan for any current grade>=1 and only enables restart rules at grade0, citing p5. Retained p5 contains supportive-care advice and no complete-resolution threshold. A generalized irinotecan SmPC rule may justify an additional restriction, but no such related source is attached and was not validated here. Preserve safeguards; seek authoritative current-source/SmPC and consultant/pharmacy clarification before any relaxation.
ANC_HOLD and PLATELETS_HOLD cite p3 Table2, but the retained official v7 Table2 is on p4. Numeric thresholds match the retained table; this is a traceability question, not a new numeric defect.
